Glacier National Park Family Trip

Four scenic days in September 2026, planned for a family with a young child.

Whole trip cartoon overview

One illustrated destination for each day.

Day 1 — Lake McDonald & Trail of the Cedars

Easy · scenery ★★★★☆

Apgar Village → Lake McDonald Lodge → Trail of the Cedars → Avalanche Gorge.

Open Day 1 route in Google Maps

Main plan

  • Apgar beach and colorful lake rocks
  • Lake McDonald Lodge shoreline
  • Trail of the Cedars boardwalk
  • Avalanche Gorge bridge
With a child: This is the easiest day. A stroller works at Apgar and on much of Trail of the Cedars.
Harder option: Avalanche Lake, 4.6 mi round trip, scenery ★★★★☆.
Skip first if tired: Avalanche Lake.

Day 2 — Going-to-the-Sun Road & Logan Pass

Most scenic day · scenery ★★★★★

Lake McDonald → The Loop → Big Bend → Logan Pass → Jackson Glacier Overlook → Wild Goose Island → Sun Point.

Open Day 2 route in Google Maps

Main plan

  • The Loop and Big Bend viewpoints
  • Logan Pass alpine meadow
  • Jackson Glacier Overlook
  • Wild Goose Island and Sun Point
With a child: Walk 20–30 minutes up Hidden Lake Trail and turn back unless everyone still has energy.
Harder option: Hidden Lake Overlook, 2.8 mi round trip, scenery ★★★★★.
Skip first if tired: the full Hidden Lake hike.

Day 3 — Many Glacier & Swiftcurrent Lake

Best lake-and-mountain family day · scenery ★★★★★

Many Glacier Hotel → Swiftcurrent Lake → boat transfer → Lake Josephine → optional Grinnell Lake walk.

Open Day 3 route in Google Maps

Main plan

  • Lake Sherburne viewpoint
  • Many Glacier Hotel and lawn
  • Swiftcurrent Lake boat dock
  • Lake Josephine short shoreline walk
With a child: The boat is the easiest way to see deep-valley scenery. Bring a child carrier for the transfer.
Harder options: Grinnell Lake, 2.2 mi round trip from the boat, or Redrock Falls, 3.6 mi round trip.
Skip first if tired: the extra hike; keep the hotel, lake, and boat area.

Day 4 — St. Mary Lake & Waterfalls

Short scenic walks · scenery ★★★★☆

Wild Goose Island → Sun Point → Sunrift Gorge → Baring Falls → return to Columbia Falls.

Open Day 4 morning routeOpen return route

Main plan

  • Wild Goose Island in morning light
  • Sun Point viewpoint
  • Sunrift Gorge short walk
  • Baring Falls
With a child: Use the carrier for Baring Falls because the return is uphill.
Harder option: St. Mary Falls, 1.6 mi round trip, scenery ★★★★☆.
Skip first if tired: St. Mary Falls and Virginia Falls.
